title: Besiege Wei to Rescue Zhao
era: Warring States · King Xian of Zhou, year 16

source.book: Records of the Grand Historian, Biographies of Sun Tzu and Wu Qi
source.quote: Strike at what he must defend, and pierce where he is undefended; when he is held in check, the siege lifts by itself.

moral: When pushing head-on gets you nowhere, move the place he cannot afford to lose.

story.title: Handan Is Surrounded
story.text: Handan was surrounded, and cart after cart came begging for help.
story.narration: In 354 BC the armies of Wei surrounded Handan, the capital of Zhao. Cart after cart of messengers raced to Qi to ask for help.

story.title: Straight for Daliang
story.text: Sun Bin pointed at the map: not Handan — go straight for Daliang.
story.narration: Sun Bin pointed at the map and said to Tian Ji: you cannot untangle a knot by tugging hard, and you cannot save Handan by pushing hard. March straight at Daliang, the city Wei must protect — and the siege of Handan will lift by itself.

keyMoment.question: Handan is sealed off. Where do you strike first?

options.text: Charge straight at Handan and fight head-on
options.hint: Head-on we are fewer — we cannot push through.

options.text: March on Daliang, the city Wei must protect
Take the long way round and raid a small border town
options.hint: Wei will not turn back for a small town.

keyMoment.reveal: Move the place he cannot afford to lose, and the siege lifts by itself.

misconceptions: If a friend is surrounded, you can only rush straight to him
Bravery means pushing hardest at the strongest point

quiz.question: Handan was in danger. Where did Sun Bin lead his army instead?
quiz.explanation: Daliang was the city Wei had to protect — as soon as Qi marched on it, the Wei army turned back.

quiz.question: Your brother's block tower is leaning, and he keeps holding the top block. How can you help better?
options: Steady the layer most likely to fall
Press the top block down harder
Tell him to keep holding it
quiz.explanation: Holding the top block fixes one block, but the tower still leans — steady the layer that would fall first, and the whole tower stands.
